name: Kailib Dillard
strengths: Dillard reads route combinations early and breaks on the ball with centerfield timing.
Dillard shows scheme flexibility -- single-high range and the hips to match from nickel looks.
Dillard's receiving background shows up in coverage mirror and recovery speed on verticals.
Dillard takes sound run-support angles and wraps in space despite a lean 6-2 / 170 frame.
weaknesses: Dillard needs functional mass to hold up vs SEC tight ends and downhill run fits in the box.
comparison: Dillard comps to Justin Simmons -- rangy 6-2 free safety with ball skills, range, and coverage IQ (size-matched to Dillard's 6-2 / 170 mold with room to fill).
projection: Dillard projects as develop into the safety room, earn early special-teams and dime snaps, then compete for a starting free safety role -- starter upside as a rangy ball hawk.
schemeFit: Dillard fits White as a single-high/split-safety who can also match in sub packages.
